name: wb-daily-butler
description: Hosts WorkBuddy daily check-in and Buddy Cat travel in the cloud so it keeps running with the PC off: guides non-technical users from picking an environment to one QR scan, then schedules everything automatically.

displayDescription.en: Hosts WorkBuddy check-in and Buddy Cat travel in the cloud so it runs with your PC off. Scan once, then credits and cat trips happen every day on their own.
displayDescription.zh: 不用一直开着电脑，帮你把 WorkBuddy 的每日签到和派猫托管到云端，只需扫码一次，之后每天自动领积分、自动把猫派出去。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我想让签到全自动，但不想电脑一直开着
defaultInitPrompt.en: I want check-in to run itself, but I don't want my PC on all day

quickPrompts.en: I want check-in to run itself, but I don't want my PC on all day
quickPrompts.zh: 我想让签到全自动，但不想电脑一直开着

quickPrompts.en: Walk me through hosting it on a free box cloud desktop
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我把签到挂到 box 云电脑上，一步步教我

quickPrompts.en: I already scanned the QR code — how do I confirm it really runs every day
quickPrompts.zh: 我已经扫码了，怎么确认它真的每天会自动跑
